scope: Proposition 6.1 (Attachment comparison) of the manuscript “Thomason Model Structures in Every Strict Higher Dimension” (preprints/Thomason-Model-Structures-in-Every-Strict-Higher-Dimension-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 317 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4297861df49692b8), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 21. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let A ⊂ B be a sieve of small posets. Let Z be its upward closure, and suppose that A ↪→ Z admits a right adjoint retraction. For every functor a : UA → X in nCat, put VB(X) = X ⨿UA UB, PB(X) = NnX ⨿NnUA NnUB. The canonical map γB,X : PB(X) −→ NnVB(X) (6.1) is a simplicial weak equivalence. The map NnUA → NnUB is a monomorphism. The comparison is natural in every functor f : X → X′ under UA.
